description: Search sedo.com's domain marketplace by keyword, browse one of its 14 top-level categories, monitor expiring domain auctions, or look up specific domains. Filter by TLD, price, traffic, domain length, listing type, bids, watchlist count, and auction deadline. Seller country, description, offer views, and exact auction values are available through the details enrichment.

categoryId.description: One of Sedo's 14 top-level domain categories. Required for mode=byCategory.
categoryId.title: Category (mode=byCategory)

domains.description: Domain names or Sedo listing/buy-now URLs to look up directly, e.g. `outlet.ai` or `https://sedo.com/search/details/?domain=outlet.ai`. Required for mode=byDomain.
domains.title: Domains or URLs (mode=byDomain)

endingWithinDays.description: Only include expiring auctions ending within this many days (mode=auctions).
endingWithinDays.title: Auction ends within (days)

includeDetails.description: Fetch each domain's Sedo detail page for seller country, member-since date, portfolio URL, description, offer views, watchlist count, parking traffic, and exact minimum-offer/auction values. Costs one extra request per record; disable for very large runs.
includeDetails.title: Include seller and detail fields

includeHyphenated.description: Include domains whose name contains a hyphen. Turn off to keep only single-token names.
includeHyphenated.title: Include hyphenated domains

includeIdn.description: Include internationalized domain names (punycode). Turn off to keep only ASCII domains.
includeIdn.title: Include IDN domains

includeNumeric.description: Include domains whose name contains digits. Turn off to keep only alphabetic names.
includeNumeric.title: Include domains with numbers

keywords.description: Optional list of keyword searches (mode=search). When non-empty, these override Search query and each keyword is searched in turn until Max items is reached. Useful for monitoring several niches in one run.
keywords.title: Keywords (multiple searches)

maxLength.description: Drop domains whose name (excluding TLD) has more characters than this.
maxLength.title: Max domain name length

maxPrice.description: Drop listings priced above this amount (approximate USD equivalent). Only applies to listings with a visible asking price.
maxPrice.title: Max price (USD)

maxReservePrice.description: Only include expiring auctions whose published reserve range ends at or below this value.
maxReservePrice.title: Max auction reserve (mode=auctions)

maxTraffic.description: Drop domains with more estimated monthly visits than this.
maxTraffic.title: Max estimated monthly traffic

minBids.description: Only include listings with at least this many bids.
minBids.title: Min bid count

minLength.description: Drop domains whose name (excluding TLD) has fewer characters than this.
minLength.title: Min domain name length

minPrice.description: Drop listings priced below this amount (approximate USD equivalent, as used by Sedo's own price filter). Only applies to listings with a visible asking price.
minPrice.title: Min price (USD)

minReservePrice.description: Only include expiring auctions whose published reserve range reaches at least this value.
minReservePrice.title: Min auction reserve (mode=auctions)

minTraffic.description: Drop domains with fewer estimated monthly visits than this.
minTraffic.title: Min estimated monthly traffic

minWatchlist.description: Only include listings watched by at least this many Sedo users.
minWatchlist.title: Min watchlist count

mode.description: What to scrape: search the marketplace by keyword, browse a category, monitor expiring auctions, or look up specific domains/URLs.
mode.title: Mode

saleType.description: Filter by how the domain is sold, matching Sedo's own Listing Type filter. mode=auctions always uses Expiring Domain Auction.
saleType.title: Sale type

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword to search Sedo's domain marketplace for (mode=search). Matches domains containing this keyword, e.g. `shop`, `crypto`, `app`.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Sort order. auctionEndTime and auctionReserve are intended for mode=auctions.
sortBy.title: Sort by

sortDescending.description: Sort highest-to-lowest (or newest-first for Date created). Uncheck for ascending order; auctions default to ending soonest.
sortDescending.title: Sort descending

tlds.description: Only include domains with one of these extensions (no leading dot), e.g. `com`, `net`, `ai`, `io`, `de`. Leave empty for all extensions.
tlds.title: TLD filter

title: Sedo Domain Marketplace Scraper Input
